name: Tower Manufacturing Corporation
old_description: Tower Manufacturing is a Leading  Manufacturer of Electrical Safety Devices and Electromechanical Products.
about:
Tower Manufacturing Corporation was founded in 1957 by Louis Shatkin in Providence, Rhode Island. The company remains under his active leadership and has grown from a regional operation into an international supplier with manufacturing sites in Providence and Shenzhen, China, plus sales offices in Hong Kong and Taiwan.

The company produces electrical safety devices — including ground-fault circuit interrupters (GFCI), leakage-current detection interrupters (LCDI), equipment leakage-current interrupters (ELCI), and appliance leakage-current interrupters (ALCI) — as well as electromechanical components such as printed circuit board assemblies, thermostats, switches, windings, solenoids, wire harnesses, and overload protection. Its Shenzhen facility spans roughly 250,000 square feet and employs about 3,000 production workers, while the Providence headquarters houses an engineering team with over 100 years of combined design experience and an on-site laboratory where qualification testing is witnessed by UL and cUL representatives.

Tower serves the construction, commercial/industrial, and residential markets, and provides OEM safety products to Fortune 500 companies. The firm participates in standards bodies including NEMA, NFPA, AHAM, and NEC, and sits on UL’s 1699 STP committee for LCDI/AFCI.

The business was built on Shatkin’s pioneering work in GFCI technology, which has yielded more than 20 patents. Tower emphasizes safety-first design to UL and CSA standards, rapid custom development, and a vertically integrated model that keeps qualification testing in-house under UL supervision.
